overview: Gib is asleep on the cloth that is on the Holinshed. He has plainly been there since July. The title is covered. You did not shift him, and you did not take the book back.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked, and did not take the book back.

assets.name: Holinshed
assets.disposition: Left the book under the cat

summary: Left the book under the cat
